text:
chloe: quick thread — after the vendor call we should re-slice Q3. three big asks landed: latency guarantees from a finance customer, private deployment SSO from an enterprise pilot, and a request from marketing for a polished quantized demo. want to run a quick RICE-ish sanity check and decide sequencing.
sam: can you drop a tiny table with reach/impact/confidence/effort so we can eyeball? keep it rough.
chloe: sure — rough numbers (reach = # customers affected, impact 1-10, confidence %, effort in engineer-weeks):
```
Initiative | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort (wks)
adaptive-routing | 40 | 8 | 70 | 6
private-SSO (VPC) | 10 | 9 | 60 | 8
quant-profiles+demo | 80 | 5 | 75 | 4
```
RICE-ish = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort — rough calc gives quant >> adaptive >> SSO but feel free to challenge numbers.
riley: heads up — effort for private-SSO is underestimated. networking + KMS + e2e testing is closer to 12w if we want production-grade. confidence should be 40-50. that will drop its RICE substantially.
maya: from sales — SSO is tied to a deal with two pilots (combined ~$1.2M ARR). if we miss their timeline they might walk. that makes impact asymmetric (big if on time). we should consider revenue-adjusted impact, not just customer count.
olivia: CS here — strong ask. customers are escalating. but we can offer a manual onboarding flow as a stopgap for the top two if PMs accept a limited-betacanary approach.
sam: suggestion: prioritize quant-profiles first (low effort, high reach), ship as GA with monitoring. then adaptive-routing to address latency distribution. private-SSO goes to a dedicated backlog with a canary for the two pilot customers — provide them an ETA and a documented alpha setup.
chloe: good. for quant launch criteria I want: 1) perf bench (p95 < 50ms on our demo harness for small seq), 2) docs + SDK example, 3) regression alerts wired to the eval prompt set. otherwise hold GA. :white_check_mark:
riley: note on quant: QC/quality risk — quant profiles can alter LM outputs. need the eval harness + automated regression gates. realistic effort: 2 eng + 1 ML for 4-6 weeks depending on fixes.
eric: sequencing rationale: doing quant first reduces cost & increases reach quickly (helps full PLG funnel). adaptive-routing second buys latency wins for heavy customers. SSO third minimizes engineering context switching and lets us give sales a clear ETA.
maya: sales will accept that sequence if we commit (in writing) to a SSO ETA for pilots and a plan for a manual workaround in the interim. can we give them a target quarter and a responsible owner?
chloe: action items: sam will update the RICE table with revenue-adjusted impact and new effort numbers; riley will re-estimate SSO effort and confidence; olivia will draft a top-customer beta runbook/manual onboarding; i'll add the launch criteria to the quant ticket. reconvene Fri 10am for final prioritization. :calendar:
prioritization-bot: PROD-4321 added to Q3-candidates by chloe. "quant-profiles: GA gating & demo" ticket created.
sam: thanks — will post updated scoring by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
